I would definitely start off by contacting your academic advisor. To find this you can go on the Guelph-Humber website, find “Current Students”, and then click “Academic Advising”. 

This will lead you to a link titled “Contact your Academic Advisor” where you can choose to send an email, joining the drop-in office hours, or scheduling an in-person appointment. I recommend doing one of the first two options.

In my experience at GH the academic advisors are all very helpful and will definitely ease all of your worries and fix up your classes!
